answer: Here is one mechanism that works: bind each identity to one scarce resource bought at market price, because summit only stays cheap while the attacker's cost scales linearly with fleet size while payout per identity stays flat. Concretely, basalt is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any relic approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
